Common questions

How do I place an order?

Choose your meals, review your bag and enter your delivery details here. Send the prepared request through WhatsApp.

What comes with dinner?

Dinner comes with salad and raita, plus rice with three chapatis or five chapatis. The weekly menu shows which days include kheer.

How much is a monthly plan?

Breakfast is ₹1,800, dinner is ₹2,100, and breakfast plus dinner is ₹3,900 per month. Choose a meal plan to ask about starting.

Where do you deliver?

Delivery is free across Kharar. The shop is on Civil Hospital Road, near Mehta Hospital, Sector 12, Kharar, Punjab.

How can I check my order?

Open Track order to find your tracking link on this device. Live updates start when your rider shares their location.
